name: Python Rod
body:
School evocation; Level: druid 4, serpent warlock 4, snake cultist leader 4, witch 4

Components: V, S, M (a python’s scale)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Duration: 1 min./level The caster summons a rod of the python that he may use without restriction, regardless of his alignment, for the duration of the spell. The caster is considered proficient with the rod, and the rod will not work for anyone else. The rod disappears when the spell ends.
